title: Across PCP - member distance
one_line_definition: This chart compares the volume of targeted care gaps across members grouped by their geographic distance from their assigned Primary Care Physician.
result_meaning: [{"movement": "Highest targeted gaps concentrated in the farthest distance buckets", "signal": "Negative", "interpretation": "Members living far from their PCP face greater access barriers, leading to more unresolved care gaps that require outreach or telehealth intervention."}, {"movement": "Highest targeted gaps concentrated in the nearest distance buckets", "signal": "Investigate", "interpretation": "Proximity to a PCP does not guarantee gap closure, suggesting care coordination, scheduling capacity, or engagement quality issues may be limiting in-office gap resolution."}, {"movement": "Targeted gaps are evenly distributed across all distance buckets", "signal": "Investigate", "interpretation": "A uniform gap distribution regardless of distance indicates that access alone is not the primary driver, and broader systemic factors such as documentation practices or risk stratification accuracy should be examined."}]
